title: The Ember award

item.name: the Ember award
item.line: A bronze flame on a stand, given in 1997. It stood in a glass case in the display room.

brief: A gala at the Baker house. At 9:30 pm every light went out.
At 9:33 the lights came back, and the 1997 Ember award was gone from its glass.
Mrs Baker has sent for you and your pet.

suspects.name: Mr Lankey
suspects.line: Runs the house's security, cameras and locks.
suspects.says: In his office, watching the cameras.

suspects.name: Mrs Okafor
suspects.line: Runs the cleaning crew at the gala.
suspects.says: Clearing the dining room with her crew.

steps.thing: The empty glass case. Grey marks where a hand held it while the award was lifted.
steps.fact: The marks make 1 print: the diamond grip of a rubber cleaning glove.
steps.lead: Your pet knows that grip. And a power cut that takes the cameras and the locks for 3 minutes is no accident. To the power box.

steps.thing: The house's power box by the back stairs. The fuses are whole.

events: 9:29. The band stops for the toast.
9:30. Every light goes out, and the cameras and the locks with them.
9:33. The lights come back. The glass is empty.

options.text: A gloved hand pulls the main switch down. The same grey grip is on it.
Wind brings down the line to the house. The night was still.
A fuse blows under the gala lights. Every fuse is whole.

steps.fact: Nothing failed. The main switch was pulled by hand at 9:30, in the same gloves.
steps.lead: Mr Lankey runs the cameras. He was in the security office.

steps.thing: Mr Lankey, at his desk of dark screens. He got out of the office at 9:44.

talk.name: Mr Lankey
talk.says: I was watching the cameras when a man in a cloak came in. He threw a coat over me and shut me in. I got out at 9:44.

asks.text: Say you are sorry for his night.
asks.answer: He thanks you. He has a house to look after, he says, and shows you to the door.

asks.text: Ask what the man looked like.
asks.answer: About 6 feet. Broad. The face covered. He saw him for a moment.

show.answer: He looks at the switch, then at you. The screens went dark at 9:30 with the rest. He saw nobody on them. He was afraid to say so.

steps.fact: Mr Lankey saw nobody on the cameras. They were dark from 9:30.
steps.lead: The cleaners sign in and out at the back door. Their book is in the staff room.
